name: DescribeVServerGroups

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CLB instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the forwarding rules associated with the vServer groups. Valid values:

- **true**: yes

- **false** (default): no
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回关联的转发规则信息。取值：

- **true**：是。
- **false**（默认值）：否
parameters.name: include_rule

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return information about the associated listeners. Valid values:

- **true**: yes

- **false** (default): no
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回关联的监听信息。取值：

- **true**：是。
- **false**（默认值）：否
parameters.name: include_listener

element_fields.help_en:
The key of tag N. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs`:
element_fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。N的取值范围：**1~20**。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The tag value. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`. The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。N的取值范围：**1~20**。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: value
